channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: NASA finds giant 10-sided pattern on Saturn
item.description: A large 10-sided atmospheric pattern has emerged around Saturn's south pole, mirroring the planet's well-known northern hexagon.

item.title: One immune switch may drive aging throughout the body
item.description: Aging could be driven partly by immune cells losing their ability to clear damaged, inflammation-promoting cells. Blocking a single receptor may restore that function.

item.title: A century-old physics assumption has been overturned by scientists
item.description: Researchers at Carnegie Mellon University found an unexpected form of the Hall effect, challenging a long-standing belief in physics about this electrical phenomenon.

item.title: Bats may resist dangerous viruses due to unique immune system
item.description: Over 500 species of vesper bats have two sets of antibody genes, an immune arrangement not seen before, which might explain their ability to carry viruses without falling ill.
